activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1030 as al-Biruni's representative Ghaznavid scholarly-activity year. His major study of India was completed in 421 AH/1030 shortly after Mahmud of Ghazni's death, and he continued scientific work under the succeeding Ghaznavid ruler Mas'ud.

sources.title: BĪRŪNĪ, ABŪ RAYḤĀN i. Life — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica states that al-Biruni completed his major work on India in 421/1030 just after Mahmud's death and continued major scientific work at the opening of Mas'ud's reign.
